segments.an4.107:1.3: Gādhaṃ kattā no vasitā, vasitā no gādhaṃ kattā, neva gādhaṃ kattā no vasitā, gādhaṃ kattā ca vasitā ca – imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso mūsikā.
segments.an4.107:1.8: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro mūsikūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.107:1.10: Gādhaṃ kattā no vasitā, vasitā no gādhaṃ kattā, neva gādhaṃ kattā no vasitā, gādhaṃ kattā ca vasitā ca.
segments.an4.107:2.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṃ kattā hoti no vasitā?
segments.an4.107:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti – suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
segments.an4.107:2.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
segments.an4.107:2.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṃ kattā hoti, no vasitā.
segments.an4.107:2.6: Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā gādhaṃ kattā, no vasitā;
segments.an4.107:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo vasitā hoti, no gādhaṃ kattā?
segments.an4.107:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti – suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
segments.an4.107:3.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
segments.an4.107:3.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo vasitā hoti, no gādhaṃ kattā.
segments.an4.107:3.6: Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā vasitā hoti, no gādhaṃ kattā;
segments.an4.107:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gādhaṃ kattā hoti no vasitā?
segments.an4.107:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti – suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
segments.an4.107:4.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
segments.an4.107:4.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gādhaṃ kattā hoti, no vasitā.
segments.an4.107:4.6: Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā neva gādhaṃ kattā hoti, no vasitā;
segments.an4.107:5.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṃ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca?
segments.an4.107:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti – suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
segments.an4.107:5.4: So ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
segments.an4.107:5.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṃ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca.
segments.an4.107:5.6: Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā gādhaṃ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca;
segments.an4.107:5.8: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro mūsikūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.

lines: Sattame yo āvāṭaṃ khaṇati, na ca tattha vasati, so gādhaṃ kattā no vasitāti vuccati.
Sattame āvāṭaṃ khanatīti attano āsayaṃ bilakūpaṃ khanati.
Na ca tattha vasatīti tattha avasitvā kismiñcideva ṭhāne vasati, evaṃ biḷārādiamittavasaṃ gacchati.
Vasitā no gādhaṃ kattāti sayaṃ na khanati, parena kate bile vasati, evaṃ jīvitaṃ rakkhati.
Imāya pana upamāya upamitesu puggalesu paṭhamo yathā sā mūsikā gādhaṃ khanati, evaṃ navaṅgaṃ satthusāsanaṃ uggaṇhāti.

Yathā pana sā tattha na vasati, kismiñcideva ṭhāne vasantī amittavasaṃ gacchati, tathā ayampi pariyattivasena ñāṇaṃ pesetvā catusaccadhammaṃ na paṭivijjhati, lokāmisaṭṭhānesu vicaranto maccumārakilesamāradevaputtamārasaṅkhātānaṃ vasaṃ gacchati.
Dutiyo yathā mūsikā gādhaṃ na khanati, evaṃ navaṅgaṃ satthusāsanaṃ na uggaṇhāti.
Yathā pana parena khanite bile vasantī jīvitaṃ rakkhati, evaṃ parassa kathaṃ sutvā catusaccadhammaṃ paṭivijjhitvā tiṇṇaṃ mārānaṃ vasaṃ atikkamati.
